title: Daily Digest B: Mackey and Davey O'Brien finalists (Wed Nov 25)
parts:
🏆 DEVYDOSE DAILY BUZZ | Wed, Nov 25

Tuesday's finalist lists kept coming. The Mackey Award has its three tight ends, and two of the three Davey O'Brien quarterbacks are up for the Maxwell too 🧵👇

🏆 MACKEY AWARD FINALISTS (top tight end)

LUKE REYNOLDS | Virginia Tech | JR, 4⭐ | #2 TE (preseason: #9)

JELANI THURMAN | North Carolina | SR, 4⭐ | #6 TE (preseason: #48)

51 catches, 610 yards and 8 TDs through 11 games for Thurman (via Chapelboro).

🏅 ELI FINLEY | Louisiana Tech | SR, 3⭐ | #19 TE (preseason: #52)

The third Mackey finalist and the only one from outside the power conferences: 57 catches, 709 yards, 8 TDs, all career highs (via Crescent City Sports).

🏆 DAVEY O'BRIEN FINALISTS (top QB, via ESPN)

DARIAN MENSAH | Miami | SR, 2⭐ | #7 QB (preseason: #70)
Leads the nation at 75.4% completions (via Miami).

DEVON DAMPIER | Utah | SR, 3⭐ | #23 QB

Gio Lopez of Wake Forest is the third.

Who's your Mackey pick? 👇
